sources.entry: webtrees - Webtrees is the web's leading online collaborative genealogy application. (Demo, Source Code) GPL-3.0 PHP

summary.one_liner: webtrees is a self-hosted, web-based collaborative genealogy application for recording, viewing and sharing family trees.
summary.what_it_does: webtrees lets you record and edit individuals, families, sources, media and other GEDCOM records in a web browser. It imports and exports standard GEDCOM files so data can move to and from desktop genealogy applications. It provides interactive charts such as pedigree, fan, descendants and relationship views. Privacy rules can be set per record, per user and per tree, and several family members can work on the same tree at once. It supports multiple trees in one installation, multiple interface languages, several themes, and a module system for extensions.
use_cases: collaborate on a family tree with relatives
control who can see living relatives' records
manage multiple family trees in one install
how_to_run: Upload and extract the release archive to an empty folder on your web server
Navigate to the URL in your browser to start the setup wizard
Create your first family tree and optionally import a GEDCOM file
stack: MySQL/MariaDB, PostgreSQL, SQLite or SQL Server
notable: Self-hosted, so the owner keeps control of the data
Standard GEDCOM import and export for compatibility with desktop genealogy software
Fine-grained privacy rules per record, user and tree
Module system with modules_v4 directory for third-party extensions
caveats: Requires a PHP host with specific extensions and a configured database; memory and execution time must be scaled to tree size
Pretty URLs need URL rewriting configured on the web server
Recommended PHP extensions such as exif and zip are optional but affect some features
